{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "direct-judge",
  "task_id": "LEV-CH01-VARIABLE-COEFFICIENT-OPENING-CLAIM-PRODUCTION-20260908",
  "source_sha256": "b3adec0d3616dbde57a5522cfce1861890887d7c03a2232d2136cb94c9bac1d5",
  "dossier_sha256": "e1621b36f4f2a35b3a27243b74d8b8f75be276c378ffcb32a9eaeccbb7287f4c",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "NumStability.IsRealHyperbolicMatrix",
      "interpretation": "There exist real eigenvalues and a real vector-space basis whose vectors satisfy the corresponding matrix eigenvector equations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires the scalar matrix [a(x)] to have a complete real eigenbasis at every spatial point.",
      "source_match": "Matches the real-eigenvalue and complete-eigenvector criterion on printed page 3, applied pointwise to the scalar case explicitly admitted on page 1.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "NumStability.RepresentsScalarTransportFlux",
      "interpretation": "For every profile p differentiable at x with derivative s, the composite y ↦ F(y,p(y)) has derivative a(x)s at x.",
      "effect_on_target": "Its negated existence excludes a single local flux F(x,q) representing the spatial operator a(x)q_x for all differentiable profiles. Constant profiles force F(x,c) to be independent of x; affine profiles then force a to be constant whenever such a flux exists.",
      "source_match": "An operator-level realization of conservation form (1.8), retaining the original dependent variable. It includes state-only fluxes as a subclass and excludes them without relying on discontinuous solutions or failed classical differentiability.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "NumStability.constantCoefficientScalarMatrix",
      "interpretation": "The one-by-one real matrix whose sole entry is the supplied speed.",
      "effect_on_target": "At x its entry is a(x); the definition does not require the spatial function a to be constant.",
      "source_match": "Matches the m = 1 reduction on printed page 1 and supplies a scalar member of the variable-coefficient class.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "NumStability.RepresentsScalarTransportFlux._proof_1",
      "interpretation": "A theorem asserting joint continuity of real multiplication as a scalar action in the displayed real topologies.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies calculus infrastructure for HasDerivAt, without imposing an extra premise on a or F.",
      "source_match": "Ordinary real differentiation in the source uses this standard continuous scalar action.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "And",
      "reuse_sha256": "94e96d1a013e57386e57cd114e8941fbf0a07288f11d1a5476f8ead74a955410",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires smoothness, positivity, pointwise hyperbolicity, and absence of a representing flux for the same coefficient.",
      "source_match": "Retains the source's class qualifiers and nonconservation conclusion, with additional properties of the existential witness.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "ContDiff",
      "interpretation": "Continuous differentiability to the supplied order via a Taylor-series family. At WithTop.some ENat.top this is smoothness to every finite order, not the separate outer-top analytic branch.",
      "effect_on_target": "Asserts that the existential coefficient is globally C-infinity on the real line.",
      "source_match": "The source does not demand this regularity; its presence strengthens the existential witness and ensures that nonconservation is not caused by rough coefficients.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "reuse_sha256": "2b3f995daeabbff34366289ad0fe1d2f4a20fb874fb638214fda15c697ed04f0",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the usual nontrivially normed real field required by differentiation.",
      "source_match": "Preserves the source's real scalar calculus.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "ENat",
      "interpretation": "Natural numbers with an additional greatest element.",
      "effect_on_target": "Its greatest element specifies infinitely many finite differentiability orders.",
      "source_match": "Encodes the extra smoothness of the witness without changing the source's spatial domain.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "Exists",
      "reuse_sha256": "195e919467600ddc9f570c6482e836c83f896a784f827427a22bb3943872c921",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects one coefficient; inside its final conjunct, negates existence of any representing flux. Also selects eigenvalues and eigenbases.",
      "source_match": "Preserves the possibility force of 'may not'; it does not assert that every variable coefficient is nonconservative.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "Fin",
      "reuse_sha256": "1e4f5bdc506addab2d0fbf322237885f14636ae1eac72413fdced9e5739c5580",
      "effect_on_target": "Fin 1 supplies exactly one matrix row, column, and basis index.",
      "source_match": "Represents the scalar m = 1 case admitted on printed page 1.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "reuse_sha256": "72c990febe13854a83db46979b5e583f5495b604de9206382dcf4f165ffa9ac4",
      "effect_on_target": "Enumerates the singleton index type used in matrix multiplication and hyperbolicity.",
      "source_match": "Provides the finite-dimensional scalar matrix convention.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "interpretation": "Projects the strict comparison relation from the supplied LT instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Together with Real.instLT, expresses a(x) > 0 everywhere.",
      "source_match": "Adds strict positivity as a property of the existential witness, not a premise restricting an arbitrary source equation.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Nat",
      "reuse_sha256": "1cfa3e4659daa07bd56063d819b74e072861753b7576b5f8707fd59dfa298203",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the dimension 1 and finite differentiability orders.",
      "source_match": "Consistent with the source's finite dimension and standard calculus.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",

    {

      "source_match": "Matches the real calculus of (1.1) and (1.8).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Not",
      "interpretation": "Logical negation, defined as implication to False.",
      "effect_on_target": "Denies existence of any F satisfying the complete representation predicate.",
      "source_match": "Expresses nonconservation of the chosen equation, rather than failure of a particular proposed flux.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",

    {

      "status": "pass"

    {

      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "interpretation": "Selects the real strict order as the LT relation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the positivity conjunct ordinary strict real positivity.",
      "source_match": "A genuine additional witness property, with no change of order convention.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {

      "source_match": "Uses ordinary real zero.",
      "status": "pass"

    {

      "status": "pass"

    {

      "name": "Top.top",
      "interpretation": "Projects the greatest element of the supplied Top instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects the infinite element of ENat in the differentiability order.",
      "source_match": "Encodes the additional smoothness property only.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {

      "name": "WithTop.some",

      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
